text: A Russian Iskander M ballistic missile carrying a cluster warhead struck Kyiv overnight.

Ukrainian drones struck the Saratov Oil Refinery.

Several Russian military aircraft were moved out of Engels 2 Air Base as more strikes were feared.

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei asked Putin for S400 air defense systems in a personal letter carried by Mohsen Rezaei, The Telegraph reports.

Moscow may hesitate given its own needs in Ukraine.

The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned eight Canadian currency exchange firms accused of helping Iranian entities dodge sanctions, some by turning rials into crypto.

Washington says Canada must not be a safe haven for the regime's money men.

Israel's military is preparing to restart its Lebanon offensive if fighting with Iran resumes, Yedioth Ahronoth reports.

Troops are reinforcing border positions and updating operational plans ahead of winter.
🚨 A U.S. Navy CMV22B Osprey squawked 7700 (general emergency) over Oman after likely leaving a carrier in the Arabian Sea.
🚨 The U.S. State Department is offering up to $20 million, plus possible relocation, for information on Iran's nuclear program, facilities, equipment and personnel.
🚨 Trump names Stephen Miller White House Chief of Staff, calling him one of his most trusted advisors. Susie Wiles moves to the Trump Political Operation.
Houthis are clearing Red Sea ship transits by email. Captains must declare no ties to the U.S., U.K., Israel or Saudi Arabia.
🚨 The Yemeni Armed Forces say they launched a missile toward Saudi troop concentrations.
Houthis destroyed numerous PLC Forces vehicles east of Bab al Mandab, using Iran made Dehlavieh and Russia made Konkurs antitank missiles.
Turkish officials say after the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement the next step is seeking parliament approval to deploy Turkish forces to Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks from Yemen.
🚨 Iran has begun handing out iodine tablets to people living near nuclear sites, a sign that large strikes could be coming.
🚨 U.S. embassies across the Middle East issued fresh travel advisories, warning of possible armed attacks by Iranian backed Houthis and Iranian efforts to target U.S. officials.
🚨 Trump confirms U.S. strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, saying forces knocked out a newly built anti aircraft device in minutes.
🚨 Jeddah International Airport is seeing disruptions, with aircraft avoiding landings there.
Trump, citing Newsmax: "Trump is a winner and he's right about Iran"
Iran wants practical steps from Washington before any negotiations begin and is unhappy with written U.S. pledges on the agreement, a senior Iranian official told Al Hadath.

🚨 U.S. Central Command is finalizing operational options against Iran.

President Trump met his national security team at the White House to weigh whether military operations should resume, Fox News reports.
🚨 An oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an explosion 16 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman, UKMTO says.
